components.title: Location Pin — Flow Field
components.description: GPGPU particle flow field applied to a 3D location pin model. Uses 4D Simplex noise to drive divergence-free particle motion. Core FlowFieldParticles class extracted from infracorp.global.

components.title: Location Pin — Particle Cloud
components.description: Clean-room GPGPU particle system using 3D value noise and curl noise via finite-difference derivatives. Independent implementation — no third-party shader code.
